title: Local call envelope

tool.description: The tool the agent called, such as files__read_file.

upstream.description: The name the local server knows the tool by.

version.description: The tool's version in the lock.

definition_hash.description: The tool's definition hash in the lock.

package_digest.description: The lock's digest of the package or binary. The local gateway refuses a command that does not match.

arguments_hash.description: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 form of the upstream arguments, after the input was shaped.

machine.description: The enrolled machine the call may run on.

nonce.description: A single-use value, at least 128 bits of randomness in base64url.

issued_at.description: When the cloud gateway signed the envelope.

expires_at.description: When the envelope stops being valid: after issued_at, and at most 30 seconds after it.

key_id.description: The first 8 bytes of the SHA-256 of the signing public key, in hex.

sig.description: The signature over the envelope's RFC 8785 bytes without its signature field.

description: One call to a local server that the cloud gateway decided and signed for the local gateway.
